correctness.rationale: For every \(m\ge2\) and \(n\ge m\), the fixed equations \(p_i=\pi^ip_0\) and \(\pi^m p_0=p_0\) are necessary and sufficient. In each target cycle of length \(\ell\), the \(\gcd(m,\ell)\) orbits under \(\pi^m\) cannot furnish \(m\) disjoint translates unless \(m\mid\ell\); then exactly one of \(m\) residue orbits may be selected. Uniform weights give compatible affine simplex maps and a PL inverse, establishing the join model including \(q=0\) and \(q=1\). Shellable joins and integral join homology give the sphere ranks. Direct bounded support enumeration and mod-two join homology checks corroborate but do not replace universal reasoning.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete infinite-family classification of actual geometric fixed-space homotopy types for two-sided graph coloring symmetries. It provides integral homology and PL models with a sharp divisibility cutoff, and it distinguishes geometric fixed points from fixed coloring vertices. The explicit three-on-six case has three fixed geometric points but no invariant coloring, while two three-cycles yield a four-loop wedge. Neither nonequivariant homotopy nor fixed-Lefschetz-character numerical data contains this information.
